Synopsis:
The player can talk to Minsc after the fight with Not-Jaheira and the Bhaal cultists. The player can persuade the Emperor to protect Minsc from the Absolute's influence

Cluster Contexts:
- LOW_Minsc_SaveFromAbsolute.json: After the fight with Not‑Jaheira and the Bhaal cultists, Minsc is knocked down, physically battered and mentally compromised — rage and the Absolute/elder‑brain influence are clouding his mind. A Jaheira (or her doppelgänger) has been killed in the skirmish, and Jaheira urges the Emperor's illithid agents to protect Minsc from the elder brain. The Emperor's council is split; some of his followers want Minsc disposed of rather than aided. The player can try to persuade the Emperor to shelter Minsc from the Absolute's control, though completely removing that influence would require the Astral Prism.

Depending on how much the player has given into Bhaal, they are either more sympathetic, or almost hostile. But either way, they are supportive and want to use their knowledge of fighting alongside Bhaalspawn in the past to convince you that you can do good

The conversation is clearly causing a lot of strain to both the Netherbrain and to the Flaming Fist.

A Jaheira (or her doppelgänger) has been killed in the skirmish, and Jaheira urges the Emperor's illithid agents to protect Minsc from the elder brain. After fighting the Bhaal Cultists, the Netherbrain has a chat with the player via a tadpoled Flaming Fist Runner in case Captain Edenosa died to the cultists. The Netherbrain explains why it got one of its tadpoled minions to intervene and that it is trying to break through the netherstones restrictions. context: After the fight with Not‑Jaheira and the Bhaal cultists, Minsc lies physically battered and knocked flat, clawing himself to all fours as rage and the Absolute/elder‑brain influence swirl through his mind. A Jaheira (or her doppelgänger) was killed in the skirmish and urged the Emperor’s illithid agents to protect Minsc from the elder brain. The Emperor’s council is split—some advisers want to shelter and contain him, while others insist he be disposed of. The player can try to persuade the Emperor to grant Minsc protection, though completely severing the Absolute’s influence would require the Astral Prism.
